correlate.executive_summary: The assessment identified several informational and low/medium-risk issues related to discoverable resources, HTTP headers, and platform fingerprints. A discoverable /ftp directory was observed (confirmed by both reconnaissance and nikto), and robots.txt lists that path — these warrant manual review for sensitive content. Multiple security-relevant headers are missing (HSTS, CSP, Referrer-Policy), and the application exposes several auxiliary headers (CORS wildcard, NEL/reporting, feature-policy, etc.) that should be reviewed and hardened where appropriate. No product/version information was available to map any findings to public CVEs.

correlate.deduplication_notes: Merged multiple observations of the same items: recon and nikto findings about /ftp (discoverable path, robots.txt disallow, and nikto's 200 on /ftp/) were combined into a single exposed /ftp finding. The robots.txt entries from recon and nikto were merged into one robots.txt finding. Platform/header observations from nikto and recon that describe the same headers (Heroku fingerprint / heroku-router) were grouped into a single platform fingerprint entry. Other nikto-reported headers and HTTP observations were grouped into logical findings (CORS-related, auxiliary reporting headers, present security headers) rather than listing each nikto line item separately.
